list.title: Templates
list.name: Name
list.emptyHint: Write it once. Send it whenever.
list.deleteBody: "{name}" will be deleted. Broadcasts that started from it keep their copy.
list.htmlChipHint: Created as HTML; opens in code mode

html.banner: Created as HTML. The block editor can't edit this layout faithfully, so it opens in code mode.
html.convertBody: The layout will be flattened into the block editor's model: tables, inline CSS and anything the blocks can't express are lost. The stored HTML only changes when you save.

editor.nameHint: Internal label. Recipients never see it.
editor.htmlSourceHint: The HTML Posta sends. Merge tags are filled in for each recipient.
editor.textSourceHint: The plain-text version, sent beside the HTML. Merge tags are filled in for each recipient.
editor.copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the text instead.
editor.stateError: Couldn't save. Your changes are kept on this device.
editor.hiddenBySupportView: Template content is hidden in support view.

previewText.label: Preview text
previewText.hintEmpty: Shown after the subject in most inboxes. Without it, they show the email's opening line.
previewText.hintFits: Shown after the subject in most inboxes.
previewText.hintLong: Most inboxes cut it off after about {max} characters.
previewText.none: No preview text. Inboxes show the email's opening line instead.

picker.label: Start from a template
picker.hint: Copies its content here. Later template edits change nothing.
picker.replaceBody: Applying this template overwrites the current body, subject and preview text.

preflight.label: Checks
preflight.codeNote: Links and images are only checked in templates built with blocks.

issue.link-empty: {node, select, button {This button has no link. Add a web address, or remove the button.} linkCard {This link card has no link. Add a web address, or remove the card.} other {This link has no web address. Add one, or remove the link.}}
issue.link-invalid: {node, select, button {This button's link} linkCard {This card's link} image {This image's link} other {This link}} isn't a full web address. Start it with https://, or use mailto: or tel:.
issue.link-insecure: {node, select, button {This button's link} linkCard {This card's link} image {This image's link} other {This link}} uses http://. Switch to https:// so it opens without a browser warning.
issue.image-src-missing: {node, select, logo {This logo} inlineImage {This inline image} other {This image}} has no source. Paste an image address, or remove it.
issue.image-src-invalid: {node, select, logo {This logo} inlineImage {This inline image} other {This image}} can't load in an inbox from that address. Use a full web address starting with https://.
issue.image-alt-missing: {node, select, logo {This logo} inlineImage {This inline image} other {This image}} has no alt text. Add a short description so screen readers can describe it.
issue.merge-field-unknown: {name} isn't a built-in variable or a contact property, so it will send blank. Pick a variable from the list, or add the property first.
issue.merge-field-unknown-suggest: {name} isn't a variable here, so it will send blank. Did you mean {suggestion}?
issue.merge-field-no-fallback: {name} has no default, so contacts without it get a blank. Add a default to the variable.
issue.merge-field-malformed: A merge field here isn't written correctly, so it would send as broken text. Write it like {example}.
issue.merge-field-braces: Two braces aren't a merge field and send as typed. Use three, like {example}.
issue.subject-empty: No subject. Whatever sends this template needs to bring its own.
issue.preview-text-empty: No preview text. Inboxes will show the email's first line instead.
issue.preview-text-long: The preview text is {length} characters; most inboxes show about {shown}. Shorten it so it isn't cut off.
issue.size-near: This email is {size} KB, close to the {limit} KB where Gmail cuts messages off. Trim some content before it grows.
issue.size-over: This email is {size} KB. Gmail cuts messages off after about {limit} KB and hides the rest. Trim images, text or styling.
